old_problem: The Item names the ambiguous `Assembles` inventory, Procedure names Fans, and DeepSeek assumes that an OEM-links object represents chassis assemblies. A link container is not a closed inventory: it does not establish expected parts, exact membership, parent/child relationships, roles, optionality or physical locations. The generic SPEC criterion supplies none of those semantics, and nearby Processor/DIMM/PSU inventory conflicts cannot be reused to define this row.
disposition_reason: Retain Engineering Decision Pending and source conflict while classifying the future work as REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION, not BLOCKED. Once the owner selects Assembles/chassis parts or Fans and supplies the matching topology/schema, either path is a bounded read-only inventory collection with no recovery-intensive mutation. The case cannot be marked RESOLVED from `Links.Oem`: navigation may expose zero, one or many vendor resources and cannot prove completeness or physical correctness. A review-layer branch contract is therefore safe, but the source-controlled target and its authoritative Expected remain pending.
decision_basis: The exact XLSX row 1626, same-row DeepSeek/test-json fields, V2 review, historical V3.1 record, pending/conflict analyses, decision register and exact-code/variant history were read. The actual next formal queue identity was reconstructed and directly opened in XLSX as Functionality row 1635 / Wistron-BMC-00906-V003 / 034875486cc4de67.

Assembly correctness is graph-based: every expected fitted part must resolve exactly once to an approved resource identity, role, parent, children and physical location, with explicit optional/absent/virtual/OEM rules. An OEM links projection proves none of those closure properties.

The Fans branch requires a different population and oracle—rotor/location, speed/units, status/health and thermal association—so it cannot be folded into an assembly relationship ledger or inferred as a copied word without row-specific authority.

DeepSeek changes the evidence model from BMC-Web inventory to a single OEM-navigation object, omits complete resource traversal and uses insecure transport/secret handling. Its YES classification therefore understates both the owner inputs and false-acceptance risk.

After scope selection, approved link traversal can remain within the verified same chassis and read only explicitly allowed resources; no disassembly, LED actuation, chassis control, power change, thermal action, firmware write or log clear belongs to this row.

ED-12 supplies no row-specific copy-error ruling; ED-20 retains genuine BMC-Web screenshots/photos; ED-24 keeps the competing source scopes visible. ED-02/ED-21 preserve this identity, ED-03/ED-13 prohibit invented OEM semantics, and ED-26/ED-33/ED-35/ED-36/ED-38 prevent retry, source loss, reduced coverage or a review-level DUT verdict.

test_case.test_name: Inventory and LEDs - Assembles — owner-defined topology or Fan branch
test_case.purpose: Preserve the row's Assembles/chassis-parts and Fans alternatives until the owner defines the authoritative domain. If assemblies are selected, validate a complete same-chassis component relationship graph; if Fans is selected, validate its independently specified population without claiming assembly coverage.
required_package: Owner overlay decision choosing Assembles/chassis parts, Fans or two separate checkpoints, including explicit disposition of the unselected Master wording
Verified SUT/BMC/chassis identity, BMC firmware/UI version, protected BMC-Web/API access, validated TLS and approved same-target resource traversal boundary
For assemblies: authoritative standard/OEM resource map and expected part/member, role, parent-child, model/serial/asset, physical-location, optional/absent/virtual/alias matrix
For Fans: independent member/rotor/location, status/health, speed/unit and thermal-association matrix
Complete raw selected resources/links/members, source-required UI screenshots/photos, physical-map corroboration, timestamps, comparison ledger and no-mutation evidence
test_case.test_command: NOT STARTED — first record the owner-selected branch. For an assembly decision, capture the BMC-Web Inventory and LEDs view and traverse only the approved same-chassis collection/member/relationship resources; retain full raw payloads and build a closed expected-versus-observed graph covering stable identities, roles, parents, children, locations, aliases and optionality. For a Fans decision, collect the separately approved full fan UI/resource population and compare its own matrix. Report missing, extra, duplicate, dangling, cross-linked, stale, malformed or mismatched entries. Do not use `curl -k`, inline passwords, `.Links.Oem` alone, unrestricted link traversal or API-only evidence in place of the required UI capture.
test_case.expected_result: Before owner resolution, the expected result is a selected domain plus its authoritative schema/matrix. Under an assembly contract, every expected fitted part appears exactly once with correct role, relationship and physical location, allowed optional/virtual nodes are identified, and no unapproved or dangling member exists. A Fans contract has its own complete member/telemetry result. Neither branch currently has a DUT verdict.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Engineering Decision Pending remains until scope and the selected authoritative matrix exist. Future assembly PASS evidence requires graph closure and one-to-one identity/location agreement, not merely a nonempty OEM link object or an HTTP success. Missing/extra/duplicate/dangling/cross-chassis/stale nodes and unexplained field differences are engineer-reviewed exceptions. Fan evidence cannot pass assembly coverage and vice versa; final PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED belongs to the end user.
safety_gate: Do not infer that `Assembles` means every OEM link, that Fans is a typo, or that adjacent inventory rows define this topology.
Constrain any future traversal to approved read-only same-target resources; reject external, recursive, cross-chassis or unknown action links.
Do not disassemble/replace hardware, actuate LEDs, alter power/thermal/fan/chassis/firmware configuration or clear SEL/dmesg/syslog/audit evidence.
Use protected credentials and validated TLS; preserve actual BMC-Web visual evidence because a resource graph alone does not validate the UI path.
Stop interpretation on unknown resource ownership, cyclic/dangling topology, stale data, incomplete members or target mismatch; never auto-retry to hide the first graph defect.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant/hash, literal Assembles/Fans conflict, owner decision and selected resource/UI schema
Same-SUT/BMC/chassis and firmware/UI identity with timestamped BMC-Web screenshots/photos
Complete approved raw collections, members and relationships plus a closed topology/location/optionality comparison ledger or the separately defined complete Fan ledger
Missing/extra/duplicate/dangling/cross-linked/stale/malformed analysis, no-mutation/session audit and preserved SEL/audit/health evidence
Current no-DUT-action/no-verdict record and future engineer-owned outcome
test_case.recovery: This review authorizes no state change. If traversal reaches an unapproved target, identity differs, graph data is incomplete or stale, stop immediately, retain the raw URI/resource/UI evidence, close the protected session and verify chassis, fan, thermal, power and firmware state remained unchanged. Do not clear logs, disassemble hardware, reboot or repeat traversal as a repair.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and DeepSeek describe three non-equivalent evidence models: assembly topology, Fans inventory and OEM navigation links. The overlay preserves them pending an explicit owner scope decision.

blocked.reason: After owner scope/schema selection, both candidate observations are bounded read-only collections with a clear stop/recovery boundary. The missing domain/topology is an engineering/project prerequisite rather than an inherently unsafe operation.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: Assembles-versus-Fans ruling; authoritative assembly resources/UI and member-role-relationship-location/optionality matrix or complete Fan matrix; same-chassis traversal bounds; protected visual/raw evidence and engineer verdict workflow.
pending.execution_status: NOT STARTED; NO OEM LINK TRAVERSAL USED AS VERDICT EVIDENCE, NO CHASSIS/FAN/THERMAL/POWER/LED/FIRMWARE/LOG/DUT ACTION AUTHORIZED OR EXECUTED

project_authority: The BMC/platform owner defines `Assembles`, approves standard/OEM resources and aliases, or selects Fans; the mechanical/chassis owner supplies expected fitted topology and locations; the operator supplies UI/physical corroboration; the end user owns verdict. They may not edit Master, treat navigation as membership or waive the distinct branch coverage.
